cohort: A single patient diagnosed with episiotomy scar endometriosis in the perineum.
finding: The report highlights the rarity of episiotomy scar endometriosis, its classical clinical presentation, and the utility of MRI for diagnosis and assessment of lesion extension.
mod_finding: Endometriosis in an episiotomy scar is extremely rare, though extra-pelvic endometriosis occurs more frequently in surgical scar sites, especially caesarean section scars.
